title: Building the Document Context Layer for AI Agents — Jerry Liu, LlamaIndex
talk_summary: Jerry Liu frames modern RAG as an agent harness plus a document context layer, with parsing, storage/search, and repeatable workflows. He details a hybrid OCR pipeline that uses fast cheap parsing by default and escalates to VLMs for hard pages, plus routing and benchmarks for cost/accuracy.

takeaways.what_they_do: Agents first scan all documents with a fast non-VLM parser, then call a slower VLM parser only for pages with tables/charts that need deeper reading.
takeaways.evidence_quote: they'll do like a fast pass over all the documents first

takeaways.what_they_do: They auto-route between cheaper specialized models and frontier models depending on whether the task needs high accuracy or low-cost bulk indexing.
takeaways.evidence_quote: auto routing between cheaper specialized models to frontier models

takeaways.what_they_do: They built ParseBench with human-verified pages and measure tables, charts, content faithfulness, and semantic formatting for how agents actually consume documents.
takeaways.evidence_quote: 2,000 human-verified pages. It measures tables, charts, content faithfulness, semantic formatting.

takeaways.what_they_do: They expose document search as a tool set including BM25, grep, vector search, reading, and scrolling so the agent can choose and iterate on queries.
takeaways.evidence_quote: retrieval, BM25, grep, vector search, reading, and scrolling

takeaways.what_they_do: For repeatable processes like invoice processing or claims, they build specialized workflows tuned for cost and accuracy instead of always delegating to a generalized agent.
takeaways.evidence_quote: instead of always offloading it to a generalized agent

takeaways.what_they_do: Extracted outputs include granular source citations and confidence scores so uncertain values can be flagged before entering downstream systems.
takeaways.evidence_quote: granular citations all the way back to the source document for every extracted output
